summary: Linn County, Oregon lookout: 1916 cabin, 1920 cupola, L-4 cab moved here in 1970; unmanned with cameras; NHLR-registered 2003. Sources disagree on early dates.

access.note: Listed as legally accessible to the public; sources do not describe the lookout itself as open to visitors

corrections.proposed: 1916 cabin and 1920 cupola built on this site; L-4 cab built 1949 at Jordan Lookout and moved here in 1970
corrections.why: The 1949 date is when the cab was built at Jordan Lookout. This site first held a cabin in 1916.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 3,835 ft (1,169 m), which matches the record. Firelookout.com and cherylhill.net give 3,977 ft. The story reports both; the record is left at the NHLR figure for editor review.
The Register and the history page agree on a cupola in 1920. The 2006 Gazette-Times quote gives 1923 for the original structure. The story reports the disagreement without choosing.

The Register and firelookout.com say the L-4 cab was moved from Jordan in 1970. The history page describes a 1969 demolition and a new 14x14 building finished in 1970 with Jordan and Swamp Mountain materials. The story gives the Register's account and notes the other.

The Register names the Oregon Department of Forestry as administrator, with its South Cascade District as cooperator. Cherylhill's directory lists the Linn Forest Protective Association. The story uses ODF, per the Register.

sources.title: Oregon's Standing Lookouts – Every Lookout in Oregon

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the first structure (1912 alidade, 1916 cabin, 1920 cupola, 1923 original per Gazette-Times) and on how the L-4 cab reached the site. No end date for staffing was found; the Register's 'no longer man' note is undated. Visitor access is not documented. Elevation conflicts: 3,835 ft (NHLR) vs 3,977 ft (firelookout, cherylhill). No photos added. Search surfaced an ODF Facebook post and an Oregon SOS record photo caption, not read.
